name: RegEvidenceHub
description: Eight bounded products: five UK regulatory preflight workflows and three industrial QA tools. Free connector tools are identified separately from metered commercial audits.

routing.human: Use humanEntry for product information or a guided human workflow. Industrial products currently use an MCP client for file audits.
routing.agent: Use mcp for the five payment-free regulatory connectors. Use commercialMcp for paid decision calls. Industrial products expose free information/status/setup tools and separately metered audit tools.

products.name: UK Taxi PHV Licensing
products.humanAction: Start a free licensing readiness check

products.name: CQC Provider Compliance
products.humanAction: Start a free statutory-notification readiness check

products.name: England Works Watch
products.humanAction: Create a Sponsor Decision Evidence Check — £49 for a dated GOV.UK evidence checkpoint plus 30-day private re-check access; no subscription or alerts.

products.name: RegEvidenceHub Waste
products.humanAction: Start a free structured readiness check, then review the £19 England Waste Compliance Preflight Report offer with 24-hour access before payment.

products.name: CableCert QA
products.humanAction: Review the product scope and connect an MCP client; free service information and CSV inspection do not run the full audit.
products.humanPayment: Commercial MCP: $0.01 USDC per audit; shared-platform one-report offer: $19 USD, 24-hour redemption window.

products.name: FactoryTalk Import Preflight
products.humanAction: Review the supported CSV scope and connect an MCP client; the free status tool does not validate files.
products.humanPayment: Commercial MCP: $0.007 USDC per audit call; no prepaid package is listed in the current shared-platform product registry.

products.name: OPC UA NodeSet Compatibility Gate
products.humanAction: Review the supported XML scope and connect an MCP client; free status and upload-setup tools do not run the compatibility audit.
products.humanPayment: Commercial MCP: $0.005 USDC per audit; no prepaid package is listed in the current shared-platform product registry.

safety: Regulatory and industrial preflight information only; not legal advice, regulator approval, engineering certification, operational safety approval, or a guarantee of compliance.
